extra_quotes: First-principles calculations were performed usingQuantum Espresso[39, 40].
Cr substitution on the Mn sublattice was modeled using both the virtual crystal approximation (VCA) and explicit supercells.
The Bloch states from the non-self-consistent field (NSCF) calculations were further transformed into maximally localized Wannier functions (MLWFs) using the WANNIER90 package [43].
Two types of Cr doped Mn 3Sn thin films were prepared using, respectively, uniform doping and modulation doping strategies, together with an undoped Mn 3Sn reference.

All films were deposited on SiO 2/Si substrates by room temperature magnetron sputtering with a base pressure of 2×10−8 Torr and a working pressure of 3×10−3 Torr, followed by post annealing at 450◦C for 1 h in vacuum (2×10−5 Torr) to promote crystallization and dopant interdiffusion.

Consequently, the measured Hall conductivity reflects both the intrinsic Berry curvature contribution and the structural and transport characteristics of the polycrystalline film and cannot be directly compared with the calculated intrinsic value.

A full treatment of configurational disorder and a quantitative separation of intrinsic and extrinsic Hall contributions would require disorder-aware transport calculations beyond the scope of the present work.
